#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd | --flag-test> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
# The course's Assignment 6 wrapper, merged with this repository's by Claude Code (7 Nov 2026).
# From the course's, new in Assignment 6:
# - `realtime` in place of a frame rate runs without --fixed-fps, for tests that wait on audio
#   (timers follow game time and fire correctly at a fixed rate, but audio plays on the clock);
#   its log is <name>_realtime.log;
# - an optional third argument sets the timeout in seconds (120 by default), for the cost script.
# Kept from this repository's Assignment 5 wrapper:
# - the Godot project is the repository root, so --path . (the course's has --path godot);
# - Godot isn't on the PATH on the author's machine, so it is found from GODOT, then `godot`,
#   then the two places the .bat launchers look;
# - the earlier checks run inside the main scene from a flag (`-- --sound-test`), so an
#   argument that starts with -- runs main.tscn with that flag instead of a tests/ script.
# The exit status is 1 if the log has SHADER ERROR or SCRIPT ERROR, and 124 if the test hung.
set -o pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1
godot="${GODOT:-$(command -v godot || true)}"
for g in ../Godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe"; do
	if [ -z "$godot" ] && [ -f "$g" ]; then godot="$g"; fi
done
if [ -z "$godot" ]; then echo "Godot not found: set GODOT to its executable"; exit 1; fi
mkdir -p logs
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
	fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
	fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
if [[ "$1" == --* ]]; then
	log="logs/${1#--}_${tag}.log"
	timeout "${3:-120}" "$godot" --headless --path . "${fps_args[@]}" -- "$1" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
else
	log="logs/$(basename "$1" .gd)_${tag}.log"
	timeout "${3:-120}" "$godot" --headless --path . --script "res://tests/$1" "${fps_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
fi
status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

## title screen (title_screen.gd), shown over this level: him curled up asleep in his
## hollow at night with the lullaby playing. New Game glides the camera in to the nap
## close-up, and play starts from there when a move key wakes him. Any `--` argument
## other than the title's own (`--title-...`) skips the title, for the debug flags below.
## Debug: `-- --screenshot=out.png [--closeup] [--pose=<state> [--left]]` saves a
## frame and quits; --pose shows the raccoon in one state: an animation of the rigged
## model (idle, walk, run, sneak, bored, sleep, climb), or with USE_SPRITES a
## cut-out (see raccoon_sprite.gd). `-- --sprites` uses the cut-outs for one run.
## `-- --sound-test` runs the automated sound check (scripts/sound_test.gd).
## Screenshot helpers: --grab-test, --climb-test, --rest-test (he naps in the hollow),
## --tick-test (the bin is knocked over), --jump-test (he jumps on frame 1, F held; he's
## at the top around frame 14), --shot-frame=N (default 45), and
## --see-collision (the raccoon half see-through, for use with --debug-collisions).
## `-- --bubble-demo` adds a yard of stand-ins for trying the thought bubbles
## (scripts/bubble_demo.gd); `-- --bubble-test` runs their automated check in it
## (scripts/bubble_test.gd), with `--bubble-shots=<folder>` for a picture of each.
## `-- --camp-test` runs the automated check of the campers' reactions to the raccoon
## at the campsite (scripts/camp_test.gd), with `--camp-shots=<folder>` for pictures.
## `-- --tasks-test` plays level 1's camp tasks and routines through and checks them
## (scripts/tasks_test.gd), with `--tasks-shots=<folder>` for pictures.
## `-- --waves-test` checks the party's sound waves (scripts/waves_test.gd), with
## `--waves-shots=<folder>` for pictures.

## (scripts/plan_test.gd), with `--plan-shots=<folder>` for pictures.

## `-- --cones-test` checks the tutorial at the camp and the campers' cones and search

const FOCUS_TIME := 0.6

func _ready() -> void:
	var pose := ""
	var pose_left := false
	var sound_test := false
	var use_sprites := USE_SPRITES
	var bubble_demo := false
	var bubble_test := false
	var bubble_shots := ""
	var camp_test := false
	var camp_shots := ""
	var tasks_test := false
	var tasks_shots := ""
	var waves_test := false
	var waves_shots := ""
	var plan_test := false
	var plan_shots := ""
	var cones_test := false
	var cones_shots := ""
	var cone_shader_test := false
	var tutorial_test := false
	var tutorial_shots := ""
	var title_mode := Array(OS.get_cmdline_user_args()).all(func(arg: String) -> bool: return arg.begins_with("--title"))
	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if arg.begins_with("--screenshot="):
			_shot_path = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
		elif arg == "--closeup":
			_closeup = true
		elif arg == "--grab-test":
			_grab_test = true
		elif arg == "--climb-test":
			_climb_test = true
		elif arg == "--rest-test":
			_rest_test = true
		elif arg == "--tick-test":
			_tick_test = true
		elif arg == "--jump-test":
			_jump_test = true
		elif arg == "--see-collision":
			_see_collision = true
		elif arg.begins_with("--shot-frame="):
			_shot_frame = int(arg.get_slice("=", 1))
		elif arg.begins_with("--pose="):
			pose = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
		elif arg == "--left":
			pose_left = true
		elif arg == "--sound-test":
			sound_test = true
		elif arg == "--sprites":
			use_sprites = true
		elif arg == "--bubble-demo":
			bubble_demo = true
		elif arg == "--bubble-test":
			bubble_demo = true
			bubble_test = true
		elif arg.begins_with("--bubble-shots="):
			bubble_shots = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
		elif arg == "--camp-test":
			camp_test = true
		elif arg.begins_with("--camp-shots="):
			camp_shots = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
		elif arg == "--tasks-test":
			tasks_test = true
		elif arg.begins_with("--tasks-shots="):
			tasks_shots = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
		elif arg == "--waves-test":
			waves_test = true
		elif arg.begins_with("--waves-shots="):
			waves_shots = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
		elif arg == "--plan-test":
			plan_test = true
		elif arg.begins_with("--plan-shots="):
			plan_shots = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
		elif arg == "--cones-test":
			cones_test = true
		elif arg.begins_with("--cones-shots="):
			cones_shots = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
		elif arg == "--cone-shader-test":
			cone_shader_test = true
		elif arg == "--tutorial-test":
			tutorial_test = true
		elif arg.begins_with("--tutorial-shots="):
			tutorial_shots = arg.get_slice("=", 1)
	_rng.seed = 7
	if title_mode and not MUSIC_ON_AT_START and not Array(OS.get_cmdline_user_args()).any(
			func(arg: String) -> bool: return arg.ends_with("-test")):
		AudioServer.set_bus_mute(AudioServer.get_bus_index("Music"), true)

	_build_environment()
	forest = Forest.new()
	forest.night = NIGHT
	forest.clearings.assign(Campsite.CLEARINGS)
	add_child(forest)
	if NIGHT:
		add_child(NightLife.new())
	_texture_ground()
	_build_props()
	# The bubble demo's yard of stand-ins stands where the campsite does.
	if not bubble_demo:
		campsite = Campsite.new()
		campsite.forest = forest
		campsite.tasks = tasks
		# Under the title the night's quiet; the party starts with New Game (start_party).
		campsite.party_from_start = not title_mode
		add_child(campsite)
		if sound_test or camp_test or tasks_test or waves_test or plan_test:
			# These skip the tutorial at the camp: everything's as it is after it.
			tasks.reveal()
			campsite.cones_on = true
	tasks.ticked.connect(func(_id: String) -> void: _ticked += 1)

	camera = Camera3D.new()
	camera.fov = CAMERA_FOV
	# Placed every frame in _process, so it isn't interpolated; it follows where
	# the raccoon is drawn instead (see _drawn).
	camera.physics_interpolation_mode = Node.PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_OFF
	add_child(camera)
	_ear = AudioListener3D.new()
	_ear.physics_interpolation_mode = Node.PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_OFF
	add_child(_ear)
	_ear.make_current()
	player = Player.new()
	player.position = Forest.START
	# Side-on to the camera and turned a little toward it, so his pose reads at once.
	player.rotation.y = deg_to_rad(-122.0)
	player.camera = camera
	player.trees = forest.climbable
	add_child(player)
	player.sound_started.connect(_count_sound)
	if title_mode:
		# Under the title he's asleep in the hollow, and stays so until it has gone.
		_first_nap = true
		player.start_asleep(forest.rest_spot, forest.rest_exit)
		player.keep_asleep = true
		_napping = true
		_sleep_view = 1.0
	if use_sprites:
		# Drawn with the author's generated images; the 3D model underneath only
		# casts his shadow and carries things.
		sprite = RaccoonSprite.new()
		sprite.player = player
		sprite.camera = camera
		sprite.forced_state = pose
		sprite.forced_left = pose_left
		player.add_child(sprite)
	else:
		player.model.forced_animation = POSE_ANIMATIONS.get(pose, pose)
		if NIGHT:
			Night.tint_raccoon(player.model)
		# Before the model's first frame, while it's still at rest (see raccoon_face.gd).
		var face := RaccoonFace.new()
		face.player = player
		add_child(face)
	if sprite and _see_collision:
		# Half see-through, so `--debug-collisions` shows his capsule inside him.
		sprite.alpha_cut = SpriteBase3D.ALPHA_CUT_DISABLED
		sprite.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.45)
	bubbles = ThoughtBubbles.new()
	bubbles.player = player
	bubbles.camera = camera
	add_child(bubbles)
	_anchor = _drawn() + PIVOT
	_place_camera()

	_task_laugh = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	_task_laugh.bus = "SFX"
	_task_laugh.volume_db = TASK_LAUGH_DB
	if ResourceLoader.exists(TASK_LAUGH_PATH):
		_task_laugh.stream = load(TASK_LAUGH_PATH)
	add_child(_task_laugh)
	var keys := Keys.new()
	keys.level = self
	add_child(keys)

	_build_ui()
	if campsite and not campsite.cones_on:
		_tutorial = CampTutorial.new()
		_tutorial.plan = _plan
		_tutorial.tasks = tasks
		_tutorial.campsite = campsite
		_tutorial.player = player
		_tutorial.camera = camera
		_tutorial.ui_layer = _ui_layer
		_tutorial.level = self
		add_child(_tutorial)
	_start_music()
	if campsite:
		campsite.music = _music
	if title_mode:
		title = TitleScreen.new()
		title.level = self
		add_child(title)
	if sound_test:
		var test := SoundTest.new()
		test.level = self
		add_child(test)
	if camp_test and campsite:
		var camp_check := CampTest.new()
		camp_check.level = self
		camp_check.shots = camp_shots
		add_child(camp_check)
	if tasks_test and campsite:
		var tasks_check := TasksTest.new()
		tasks_check.level = self
		tasks_check.shots = tasks_shots
		add_child(tasks_check)
	if waves_test and campsite:
		var waves_check := WavesTest.new()
		waves_check.level = self
		waves_check.shots = waves_shots
		add_child(waves_check)
	if plan_test and campsite:
		var plan_check := PlanTest.new()
		plan_check.level = self
		plan_check.shots = plan_shots
		add_child(plan_check)
	if cones_test and campsite:
		var cones_check := ConesTest.new()
		cones_check.level = self
		cones_check.shots = cones_shots
		add_child(cones_check)
	if cone_shader_test and campsite:
		# Loaded only under its flag, so normal play doesn't load a file from tests/.
		var shader_check = load("res://tests/cone_shader_test.gd").new()
		shader_check.level = self
		add_child(shader_check)
	if tutorial_test and campsite:
		var tutorial_check = load("res://scripts/tutorial_test.gd").new()
		tutorial_check.level = self
		tutorial_check.shots = tutorial_shots
		add_child(tutorial_check)
	if bubble_demo:
		var demo := BubbleDemo.new()
		demo.level = self
		add_child(demo)
		if bubble_test:
			var check := BubbleTest.new()
			check.level = self
			check.demo = demo
			check.shots = bubble_shots
			add_child(check)

# brief says"). It loads effects/leaf_burst.tscn and reads every setting the brief's "The
# settings" names back from the loaded nodes and resources, with the brief's values as the
# expected ones; plus what the brief's rules and CLAUDE.md ask of the scene itself: one
# Node3D root over Leaves and Puff, nothing emitting at load, no fixed seed, and no script.
# It prints one PASS or FAIL line per check and quits 1 on any failure. Run it with:
#   bash scripts/run-test.sh test_leaf_burst_config.gd 60
# A headless run draws nothing: this reads the settings, not the look (the frame strip has
# that). The hop-out's amount_ratio 0.5 is set on its copy at the event, not in the scene,
# so here it is read as 1.0. Written by Claude Code on 7 Nov 2026.

const SCENE := "res://effects/leaf_burst.tscn"
const Forest := preload("res://scripts/forest.gd")

## The brief's settings table, per emitter. Node settings first, then the process
## material's, then the mesh's.
const NODE := {
	"Leaves": {"amount": 18, "one_shot": true, "explosiveness": 0.9, "lifetime": 0.9,
		"preprocess": 0.0, "local_coords": false},
	"Puff": {"amount": 12, "one_shot": true, "explosiveness": 1.0, "lifetime": 0.35,
		"preprocess": 0.0, "local_coords": false},
}
const PROCESS := {
	"Leaves": {"lifetime_randomness": 0.2,
		"emission_shape": ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE,
		"emission_sphere_radius": 0.55, "emission_shape_offset": Vector3(0, 0.5, 0),
		"direction": Vector3(0, 1, 0), "spread": 70.0,
		"initial_velocity_min": 2.0, "initial_velocity_max": 3.2,
		"gravity": Vector3(0, -3.5, 0), "damping_min": 2.0, "damping_max": 3.0,
		"angle_min": 0.0, "angle_max": 360.0, "scale_min": 1.0, "scale_max": 1.0},
	"Puff": {"lifetime_randomness": 0.0,
		"emission_shape": ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE,
		"emission_sphere_radius": 0.4, "emission_shape_offset": Vector3(0, 0.5, 0),
		"direction": Vector3(0, 1, 0), "spread": 180.0,
		"initial_velocity_min": 1.0, "initial_velocity_max": 2.0,
		"gravity": Vector3(0, 0, 0), "damping_min": 4.0, "damping_max": 4.0,
		"angle_min": 0.0, "angle_max": 0.0, "scale_min": 1.0, "scale_max": 1.0},
}
const MESH_SIZE := {"Leaves": Vector2(0.12, 0.08), "Puff": Vector2(0.04, 0.04)}
## Both: 3.2 x 2.2 x 3.2 m round the bush (centred on it across the ground).
const AABB_SIZE := Vector3(3.2, 2.2, 3.2)
## Leaves fade: alpha 1 until 66% of the life, then down to 0. Puff: 1 down to 0.
const FADE := {"Leaves": [[0.0, 1.0], [0.66, 1.0], [1.0, 0.0]], "Puff": [[0.0, 1.0], [1.0, 0.0]]}

			_check("%s exists" % emitter_name, false)
			continue

	_finish()


func _check_emitter(n: String, p: GPUParticles3D) -> void:
	print("-- %s" % n)
	# Emission (on the node).
	for key: String in NODE[n]:
		_expect(n, key, p.get(key), NODE[n][key])

		% [n, p.amount_ratio], is_equal_approx(p.amount_ratio, 1.0))

		% [n, centre, box.position], is_zero_approx(centre.x) and is_zero_approx(centre.z)
		and is_zero_approx(box.position.y))

	var m := p.process_material as ParticleProcessMaterial
	_check("%s: process_material is a ParticleProcessMaterial (got %s)"
		% [n, p.process_material.get_class() if p.process_material else "null"], m != null)
	if m:
		for key: String in PROCESS[n]:
			_expect(n, key, m.get(key), PROCESS[n][key])
		_check_fade(n, m.color_ramp)

		else:

	var q := p.draw_pass_1 as QuadMesh
	_check("%s: draw_pass_1 is a QuadMesh (got %s)" % [n, p.draw_pass_1.get_class() if p.draw_pass_1 else "null"], q != null)
	if q == null:
		return
	_expect(n, "QuadMesh.size", q.size, MESH_SIZE[n])
	var d := q.material as StandardMaterial3D
	_check("%s: the quad's material is a StandardMaterial3D (got %s)"
		% [n, q.material.get_class() if q.material else "null"], d != null)
	if d == null:
		return
	_expect(n, "shading_mode (UNSHADED)", d.shading_mode, BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED)
	_expect(n, "vertex_color_use_as_albedo (predicted failure 1)", d.vertex_color_use_as_albedo, true)
	_expect(n, "transparency (ALPHA, predicted failure 2)", d.transparency, BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA)
	_expect(n, "blend_mode (MIX, not additive)", d.blend_mode, BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_MIX)
	_expect(n, "billboard_mode (PARTICLES)", d.billboard_mode, BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES)
	_check("%s: no material_override hiding the quad's material" % n, p.material_override == null)


## color_ramp, fade only: every stop white (colour and size unchanged), alpha as FADE.
func _check_fade(n: String, tex: Texture2D) -> void:
	var g := _gradient(n, "color_ramp", tex)
	if g == null:
		return
	var want: Array = FADE[n]
	_check("%s: color_ramp has %d stops (got %d)" % [n, want.size(), g.get_point_count()],
		g.get_point_count() == want.size())
	if g.get_point_count() != want.size():
		return
	for i in want.size():
		var c := g.get_color(i)
		_check("%s: color_ramp stop %d at %.2f, white, alpha %.1f (got %.2f, %s)"
			% [n, i, want[i][0], want[i][1], g.get_offset(i), c],
			is_equal_approx(g.get_offset(i), want[i][0]) and is_equal_approx(c.a, want[i][1])
			and is_equal_approx(c.r, 1.0) and is_equal_approx(c.g, 1.0) and is_equal_approx(c.b, 1.0))
	_check("%s: color_ramp interpolates linearly (a smooth fade)" % n,
		g.interpolation_mode == Gradient.GRADIENT_INTERPOLATE_LINEAR)


## Leaves' color_initial_ramp: one colour picked at random per leaf (constant
## interpolation), yellow-greens lighter than the bush and some of the forest's
## fallen-leaf oranges and browns (forest.gd, LEAVES), all opaque.
func _check_leaf_colours(tex: Texture2D) -> void:
	var g := _gradient("Leaves", "color_initial_ramp", tex)
	if g == null:
		return
	_check("Leaves: color_initial_ramp is constant, one colour per leaf, no blends",
		g.interpolation_mode == Gradient.GRADIENT_INTERPOLATE_CONSTANT)
	var greens := 0
	var browns := 0
	for i in g.get_point_count():
		var c := g.get_color(i)
		_check("Leaves: colour %d #%s opaque" % [i, c.to_html(false)], is_equal_approx(c.a, 1.0))
		if c in Forest.LEAVES and c.r > c.g:
			browns += 1
		elif c.g >= c.r and c.g > c.b and c.get_luminance() > Forest.BUSH.get_luminance():
			greens += 1
		else:
			_check("Leaves: colour %d #%s is a yellow-green lighter than the bush or a fallen-leaf brown"
				% [i, c.to_html(false)], false)
	_check("Leaves: yellow-greens lighter than the bush #%s (got %d)" % [Forest.BUSH.to_html(false), greens], greens > 0)
	_check("Leaves: a few fallen-leaf oranges and browns, fewer than the greens (got %d)" % browns,
		browns > 0 and browns < greens)


## Puff's color_initial_ramp: pale tan flecks, opaque.
func _check_puff_colours(tex: Texture2D) -> void:
	var g := _gradient("Puff", "color_initial_ramp", tex)
	if g == null:
		return
	for i in g.get_point_count():
		var c := g.get_color(i)
		_check("Puff: colour %d #%s is a pale tan (r > g > b, light, opaque)" % [i, c.to_html(false)],
			c.r > c.g and c.g > c.b and c.v > 0.7 and c.s < 0.4 and is_equal_approx(c.a, 1.0))


func _gradient(n: String, what: String, tex: Texture2D) -> Gradient:
	var t := tex as GradientTexture1D
	_check("%s: %s is a GradientTexture1D (got %s)" % [n, what, tex.get_class() if tex else "null"], t != null)
	if t == null:
		return null
	_check("%s: %s has a Gradient" % [n, what], t.gradient != null)
	return t.gradient


func _expect(n: String, key: String, got: Variant, want: Variant) -> void:
	var ok: bool
	match typeof(want):
		TYPE_FLOAT:
			ok = typeof(got) in [TYPE_FLOAT, TYPE_INT] and is_equal_approx(float(got), want)
		TYPE_VECTOR2, TYPE_VECTOR3:
			ok = typeof(got) == typeof(want) and got.is_equal_approx(want)
		_:
			ok = typeof(got) == typeof(want) and got == want
	_check("%s: %s = %s (got %s)" % [n, key, want, got], ok)


func _check(what: String, ok: bool) -> void:
	if not ok:
		_failed += 1
	print("%s  %s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what])


func _finish() -> void:
	print("%s: %d check(s) failed" % ["FAIL" if _failed else "PASS", _failed])
	quit(1 if _failed else 0)

content.text:
I built Effect A and added the configuration test and the preview. The config test passes at 60 fps. I haven't run the preview at all: running Godot outside `run-test.sh` needed your approval, so I didn't. Nothing is wired into gameplay, no `.gdshader` was touched, and nothing is committed.

## What I added
- **`effects/leaf_burst.tscn`**: a `Node3D` root called `LeafBurst` with two `GPUParticles3D` children, `Leaves` and `Puff`. Every setting is in the scene file: each emitter has its `ParticleProcessMaterial`, a `QuadMesh` and a `StandardMaterial3D`. There is no script. `emitting` is off at load, `amount_ratio` is 1.0 and the fixed seed is off.
- **`tests/test_leaf_burst_config.gd`**: loads the scene and reads back every row of the brief's settings table, plus the draw settings, `visibility_aabb` and `preprocess`. It also checks the rules for the scene itself: the two named children, nothing emitting at load, no fixed seed, no scripts.
- **`previews/leaf_burst_preview.tscn`** and **`.gd`**:
  - **Background:** it instances `main.tscn`, so the bush, night grass, fire light and fog are the game's own.
  - **Camera:** each frame it moves the camera onto the bush, using `main.gd`'s pitch, yaw, field of view, distance and aim at the default zoom.
  - **Bursts:** a fresh copy fires at frame 10. With the `retrigger` export on (the default), a copy with `amount_ratio` 0.5 fires at frame 20. Each copy is freed on a timer.
  - **Seed:** `use_fixed_seed` and `seed` are set on the preview's copies only.

## Config test output
`bash scripts/run-test.sh test_leaf_burst_config.gd 60`, exit 0. All 112 checks passed; this is a short extract:
```
Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf - https://godotengine.org
Effect A, the leaf burst: res://effects/leaf_burst.tscn
PASS  root is a Node3D (got Node3D)
PASS  children are exactly Leaves and Puff, both GPUParticles3D (got ["Leaves:GPUParticles3D", "Puff:GPUParticles3D"])
-- Leaves
PASS  Leaves: amount = 18 (got 18)
PASS  Leaves: explosiveness = 0.9 (got 0.89999997615814)
PASS  Leaves: lifetime_randomness = 0.2 (got 0.2)
PASS  Leaves: emission_shape_offset = (0.0, 0.5, 0.0) (got (0.0, 0.5, 0.0))
PASS  Leaves: color_ramp stop 1 at 0.66, white, alpha 1.0 (got 0.66, (1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
PASS  Leaves: vertex_color_use_as_albedo (predicted failure 1) = true (got true)
PASS  Leaves: transparency (ALPHA, predicted failure 2) = 1 (got 1)
...
PASS  Puff: billboard_mode (PARTICLES) = 3 (got 3)
PASS  Puff: no material_override hiding the quad's material
PASS: 0 check(s) failed
```
The full log is in `logs/test_leaf_burst_config_60fps.log`. I didn't deliberately break a setting to confirm the test would fail.

## Where I differed from the brief or filled gaps
- **Mesh:** the brief says the leaf quad is "built in code". Your instruction and CLAUDE.md both put settings in the scene, so it's a `QuadMesh` in the scene file instead: 0.12 × 0.08 m for leaves, 0.04 m for flecks.
- **Colours** (the brief describes them but gives no exact values):
  - Leaves: yellow-greens `#7d8a45`, `#8fa04a`, `#a3b052`, `#6f8f3e`, and browns/oranges `#a8763a`, `#c96a32`, `#b85a2e`. `#7d8a45` and the three browns/oranges are from the forest's `LEAVES`; the other three greens are my picks.
  - The leaves' colour ramp uses constant interpolation, so each leaf gets one of those colours rather than a blend.
  - Flecks: `#d9c49b` to `#c4ab84`.
- **`visibility_aabb`:** 3.2 × 2.2 × 3.2 m, centred on the bush and starting at ground level. The brief doesn't say how high it should sit, so starting it at the ground was my choice.

## Things to look for in the strip
- **The colours may come out paler than these hex codes.** I believe the colour-ramp values are treated as linear unless `vertex_color_is_srgb` is on, but I haven't confirmed that on 4.7.2. The brief doesn't name that flag, so I didn't set it. Changing it would need a dated revision of the brief.
- **Fog and night lighting:** the material is unshaded, so the night doesn't darken the leaves, and fog still applies (`disable_fog` is not set). Both follow the brief.
- **`amount_ratio` 0.5** on a one-shot burst is still unconfirmed on this build.
- **No camper lean in the preview camera.** In play the camera leans toward a nearby camper; the preview aims straight at the bush.
- **Title screen:** `main.gd` shows the title screen when it gets no `--` argument, so the preview has to be given one.

## Capture command
Run this in Git Bash from the repo root. It's a windowed run, not headless:
```bash
mkdir -p logs/a6-leaf-burst-strip
../Godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe --path . --resolution 1280x720 --fixed-fps 30 --quit-after 60 \
  --write-movie "$PWD/logs/a6-leaf-burst-strip/frame.png" \
  res://previews/leaf_burst_preview.tscn -- --leaf-burst-preview
```
- The strip should be `frame00000010.png`, `…12`, `…15`, `…20`, `…30` and `…50`.
- The console prints the frame each burst fires on and how many bursts are alive at each strip frame. Check that the PNG numbered 10 is the one with the first flecks, since I haven't confirmed the numbering.
- To capture without the retrigger, add `--retrigger=off` after `--leaf-burst-preview`.
